messages:
emma: quick catch from the Console Observability quickstart PR: the dashboard example shows aggregation: "per_token" but telemetry now exposes per_unit. also the JS snippet omits the trace header so correlations break.

ryan: can you paste the snippets?

emma: dashboard snippet around line 78:

```json
{"metric": "cost.breakdown.v1", "aggregation": "per_token", "group_by": ["user_id"]}
```

and the JS sample is just:

```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: KEY });
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1' });
```

zoe: two small fixes: 1) swap metric to "cost.unit.v2" and aggregation to "per_unit"; 2) add header in SDK: `{ headers: { 'x-redwood-tracekey': trace.id } }`. also add a 1-line migration note about per_token -> per_unit semantics.

ryan: i'll make the PR. will also add a tiny compatibility table showing old metric -> new metric and a PromQL example for conversion.

emma: please also add a short callout about header normalization when behind proxies (lowercase). we hit that in staging and lost the header.

ryan: good call. adding: "Note: proxies may normalize header case; ensure 'x-redwood-tracekey' is preserved in lowercase."

ci-bot: lint queued for PR 10021. linkcheck: https://docs.internal/redwood/legacy-telemetry -> 301 to /telemetry/migrations; please update absolute links.

ryan: fixed links and pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10021 (WIP)

zoe: adding Python parity snippet and a 2-row compatibility table (metric, example query). will push shortly.

sam: once merged can someone trigger the docs deploy? I want to run a quick smoke on the cost dashboard before the analytics export on Monday.

ryan: merged and asked @sam to run preview checks.

ci-bot: CI passed. preview available: https://preview.docs.redwood/10021

sam: preview looks good. ran the converted PromQL example and dashboard renders. i'll deploy and monitor for 30m.

ci-bot: docs build started: https://ci.internal/builds/7999

ci-bot: build success. deploy queued.

sam: deploy complete. monitoring 35m: trace correlation fixed and no cost spikes. thanks everyone.

emma: perfect, thanks :tada:
